Subject: Spike in latency and 5xx after v5.2 deployment

Hi David / Tom here (cc'd),

We started seeing a sharp P95 latency increase and intermittent 5xx errors starting ~08:50 PDT after you pushed v5.2 with the new INT8 qprofile. Traffic patterns are unchanged on our side. P95 has jumped from ~220ms to ~1.1s and we are seeing a ~1.8% 5xx rate on inference endpoints that previously had <0.1%. Attached are our Grafana screenshots and a sample of the error payloads.

This is affecting claim-processing at scale — queues are backlogged and throughput has dropped about 30%. Can you confirm if any model or runtime change was made around that time and what immediate steps you can take? We need a short mitigation timeline (rollback window or hotfix) and an ETA for full recovery.

Sophie Lang
Head of Platform Engineering
Beacon Insurance

Attachments: p95-graphs-20260716.png; beacon_error_samples.txt

Subject: RE: Fwd: Spike in latency and 5xx after v5.2 deployment — initial triage

Quick triage notes (observations from infra + runtime traces):
- We pushed v5.2 with INT8 q1 profile at 08:32 to Beacon's pool. The INT8 execution path uses a new fused-kernel for matmul that is sensitive to sequence length distribution.
- Telemetry shows increased KV-cache churn for long-tail sessions which is causing more frequent cache rehydrates and higher token decode cost — P95 jumps as a result.
- The 5xxs are primarily OOM/retry throttles surfaced in the worker agent when memory spikes during rehydrate. See attached trace_v5.2-snippet.log.

Immediate mitigations I can execute now:
1) Re-route Beacon traffic to the float16 variant (v5.1) for their reserved pool — quick config flip, should reduce P95 and eliminate OOMs; cold-warm warmup expected but acceptable.
2) If that can't be done fast enough, roll a targeted rollback of v5.2 on Beacon's pool only.

Estimate: route-to-fallback ~20–30 minutes if we don't hit warmup pressure. Target rollback ~45–60 minutes.

I'm standing by to run either — need explicit go from David/Marissa.

—Aditya
Senior SW Engineer, Inference Runtime
